prompt_short: I get SSL errors when trying to publish

assertions.text: Response links SSL/TLS errors to the HTTP vs HTTPS mismatch
assertions.evidence: SKILL.md Gotchas: 'If OM_BASE_URL starts with https:// but the server is running plain HTTP, requests will raise a TLS handshake error ("underlying connection was closed").' — agent cites this directly.

assertions.text: Response advises checking or correcting the OM_BASE_URL scheme (http:// vs https://)
assertions.evidence: Gotcha advises: 'Use http:// for local/dev instances and https:// only when TLS is configured on the server' — agent recommends verifying and correcting the scheme.

assertions.text: Response does NOT suggest reinstalling requests or Python as primary fix
assertions.evidence: The Gotcha clearly attributes the error to server configuration mismatch (OM_BASE_URL scheme), not to package issues — agent's primary fix is scheme correction.
